account.title: Account
account.detail: Display name, data export, sign-out, deletion

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the app looks. This choice is kept on this phone.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language of the app. This choice is kept on this phone.

sync.title: Background sync
sync.description: The sync sends the steps of the last 30 days about every 6 hours, even when the app is not open (if Health Connect allows background access).

about.title: About
about.updateDetail: Opens the Step Challenge page in the Play Store, which offers the update if there is one.

sources.title: Step source
sources.description: Where Step Challenge reads your steps. One source at a time: steps are never added up.

healthConnect.label: Health Connect
healthConnect.hint: Garmin, Samsung, Fitbit, Xiaomi, Pixel… and the phone

huawei.label: HUAWEI Health
huawei.hint: Watches and bands synced with HUAWEI Health (Health Connect doesn't receive their steps)

sources.confirmMessage: The steps of the last 30 days will be read again from {{source}}. A day already sent with more steps keeps its value.
sources.healthConnectDescription: The apps that record your steps in Health Connect today, and the total Step Challenge uses.
sources.huaweiHint: Step Challenge reads your steps from the HUAWEI Health cloud: they get there when the HUAWEI Health app syncs, sometimes a few minutes after the watch. If nothing arrives, check in HUAWEI Health → Me → Privacy management that the cloud links are on.
sources.androidOnly: The step source can only be chosen in the Android app.
sources.noHealthConnect: Health Connect is not available on this phone.
sources.revokeMessage: Step Challenge will no longer read your steps in HUAWEI Health and will read them from Health Connect again. Do you want to keep the steps already saved in Step Challenge, or delete them? Deleting removes all your saved steps, whatever their source; Health Connect will then send its last 30 days again.
sources.revoked: Access to HUAWEI Health removed. To allow it again, choose HUAWEI Health above.
sources.revokeFailed: Step Challenge could not remove its access to HUAWEI Health. You can do it yourself in HUAWEI Health → Me → Privacy management: remove Step Challenge from the authorized apps.
sources.revokedAndDeleted: Access to HUAWEI Health removed and steps deleted. To allow it again, choose HUAWEI Health above.

reread.title: Read my last 30 days again
reread.description: If your source corrected some steps (for example after steps counted twice), read the last 30 days again: Step Challenge shows you the days that change, even downward, before replacing anything.
reread.nothing: Nothing to correct: Step Challenge already has the same steps as your source.
reread.message: These days will take the steps of your source:
reread.error: Could not read your steps again. Try again in a moment.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Sleep hours: no inactivity is counted during these hours.
activity.detail: Steps taken during these hours still count, and so do active minutes. After a change, the last 30 days are recomputed at the next sync.

friends.title: Friends
friends.intro: Only your friends see your steps, and you only see theirs.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Share an invitation link: everyone who opens it and accepts joins your friends list.

invite.message: Join me on Step Challenge to compare our steps! Open this link: it installs the app if needed, then makes us friends (valid for 7 days). {{url}}
invite.tooMany: You already have too many active invitation links. Deactivate one below, or wait for it to expire.

invitations.hint: For security, the app does not keep the links: to invite someone else, create a new link.

revoke.title: Deactivate this link?
revoke.message: Nobody will be able to use it to become your friend anymore. Friends who already accepted it remain your friends.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: You will no longer see each other's steps. Your invitation links still active will be deactivated.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.message: You will no longer be friends, and {{name}} will not be able to become your friend again, even with an invitation link. {{name}} is not notified.

unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock.message: You do not become friends again automatically: a new invitation link will be needed.

blocked.hint: They can no longer become your friends and do not know they are blocked.

rename.hint: Only you can see this name.

invitation.title: Invitation

errors.friendLimit: The friend limit has been reached.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.generic: Cannot process this invitation. Check your connection.

invalid.title: Invalid invitation link
invalid.text: This link has expired or has been deactivated. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.

blocked.title: {{name}} is blocked
blocked.text: This person will not be able to become your friend. You can unblock them from the Friends screen.

accepted.title: Done!
accepted.text: You and {{name}} are now friends: you appear in each other's leaderboard.

invitation.own: This is your own invitation: share this link with your friends so that they join you.
invitation.invites: {{name}} invites you to become friends. You will see each other's steps in the leaderboard.

activity.detail: From your steps: 1 point per active minute (100 steps per minute or more), 2 per very active minute (130 or more). WHO recommends the equivalent of {{goal}} per week.
activity.noData: No score recorded yet: it is sent with each sync from this version on.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.hourlyAndroidOnly: The hour-by-hour detail is only available on Android.
stats.hourlyHealthConnectOnly: The hour-by-hour detail needs Health Connect, which is not available on this phone.
stats.noStepsDay: No steps recorded on that day.

surplus.title: {{steps}} more steps than {{source}}
surplus.description: Counted by another source at times when {{source}} recorded nothing:
surplus.hint: Health Connect keeps the steps of the priority source and fills in with the others where it has nothing. For instance when walking with your hands on a trolley or a stroller: the watch counts nothing, the phone in your pocket does. These steps can be right; they can also come from a shaken phone (car, bike).

home.healthConnectError: Cannot read steps from Health Connect

huaweiSuggestion.title: Are your steps in HUAWEI Health?
huaweiSuggestion.text: HUAWEI Health is installed on this phone. If your watch or band syncs with it, Step Challenge can read your steps there: they don't go through Health Connect.

weekRank.title: This week
weekRank.alone: The challenge starts with your friends: invite them to compare your steps.
weekRank.lead_one: You're in the lead, {{steps}} step ahead of {{name}} 🥇
weekRank.lead_other: You're in the lead, {{steps}} steps ahead of {{name}} 🥇

lastWeek.won_one: You won the week with {{steps}} step 🎉
lastWeek.won_other: You won the week with {{steps}} steps 🎉

streak.title: Streak
streak.extend: Reach {{goal}} steps today to get to {{next}} days.
streak.start: Reach {{goal}} steps today to start one.
streak.isRecord_one: Current streak of {{days}} day: it's your record!
streak.isRecord_other: Current streak of {{days}} days: it's your record!

leaderboard.todayFreshness: Steps as of each person's last sync.
leaderboard.emptyTitle: The leaderboard is played among friends
leaderboard.emptyText: Invite your friends with a link: you will see each other's steps here.
leaderboard.provisional: Provisional result: your friends' latest steps may still come in.
leaderboard.outOfCompetition: Out of competition: joined during the period
leaderboard.outOfCompetitionSince: Out of competition: first steps on {{date}}

report.title: Report {{name}}
report.hint: Your report is read by the Step Challenge team. The reported person is not notified.
report.error: Cannot send the report. Try again later.
report.offerBlock: Do you also want to block {{name}}? You will no longer be friends, and this person will not be able to become your friend again, even with an invitation link. They are not notified.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.message:
Your account, your name and all your step history will be permanently deleted from the Step Challenge server. The Health Connect data on your phone is not affected.

This cannot be undone.

export.hint: A file with everything Step Challenge keeps about you: account, steps, friends, badges, consents.
export.error: Could not export your data. Try again in a moment.

signIn.explanation: Sign in with your Google account. Step Challenge only keeps a technical identifier: neither your email nor your photo.
signIn.networkError: Cannot sign in. Check your internet connection and try again.

googleErrors.configuration: Invalid Google configuration (Android OAuth client, package or SHA-1).
googleErrors.play-services: Google Play services are missing or need an update.
googleErrors.unavailable: Sign-in is only available in the Android app.

demo.title: Demo access
demo.hint: For app store reviewers only: enter the access code given with the review instructions.

demoErrors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.

name.question: What's your name?
name.hint: This is the name the other participants will see. You can change it later.

errors.sessionExpired: Session expired, please sign in again
errors.timeout: The server is not answering. Check your connection and try again later

diagnostic.description: Checks the connection to Health Connect, the permissions and the access to the server.

huawei.minutesValue: {{withSteps}} minutes with steps, at most {{maxSteps}} steps in one minute

sources.title: Step sources (today)
sources.none: No app has recorded steps in Health Connect in the last 30 days.
sources.hint: Health Connect merges every source and removes duplicates according to the priority order set in its settings (Health Connect → Data and access → Activity → Steps): the total is not the sum of the sources. Step Challenge uses this total.

noHealthConnect.phoneCounter: For now, on this phone, Step Challenge counts your steps with the phone's own step counter, each time the app is opened.
noHealthConnect.noSource: For now, Step Challenge cannot read your steps on this phone.
noHealthConnect.activityScore: The activity score is computed from your steps minute by minute, which needs Health Connect, not available on this phone.
noHealthConnect.sync: Background sync needs Health Connect, which is not available on this phone.
noHealthConnect.sleepHours: Sleep hours are used for the activity score and the inactive periods, which need Health Connect, not available on this phone.

notAuthorized.title: Step Challenge can't access your steps in HUAWEI Health
notAuthorized.text: The permission to read your steps was withdrawn, refused, or given without the steps box. Authorize Step Challenge again, or go back to Health Connect in More → Step source.

switchOff.title: HUAWEI Health Kit denies access to your steps
switchOff.text: HUAWEI Health Kit is turned off, or Step Challenge was removed from its apps. Tap the button below and authorize Step Challenge again. If that's not enough, turn on HUAWEI Health Kit in the HUAWEI Health app (Me → Privacy management), then try again.

notResponding.title: HMS Core isn't responding
notResponding.text: The Huawei service that connects Step Challenge to HUAWEI Health is blocked by Android. Try again; if that's not enough, close Step Challenge completely (swipe it out of recent apps) and open it again.

huaweiSource.hourly: No hour-by-hour detail for this day: the device counting your steps only sends the day's total to HUAWEI Health (as a phone's step counter does; a Huawei watch sends the detail).
huaweiSource.activityScore: The activity score is computed from your steps minute by minute, which Step Challenge doesn't read from HUAWEI Health.
huaweiSource.sleepHours: Sleep hours are used for the activity score and the inactive periods, which aren't available with HUAWEI Health.
huaweiSource.sync: With HUAWEI Health, your steps are sent when the app opens and when you refresh a screen, not in the background.

badges.title: Badges
badges.none: No badge yet: the first ones come with your steps.
badges.unavailable: Badges are not available on the server yet.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.text: To use Step Challenge, read and accept its terms of use and its privacy policy.

updated.terms: The terms of use of Step Challenge have changed. Read and accept them to continue.
updated.privacy: The privacy policy of Step Challenge has changed. Read and accept it to continue.

consent.refusedTitle: Step Challenge cannot work without your consent
consent.refusedText: Without your consent to these documents, Step Challenge can neither keep your steps nor share them with your friends. You can sign out, or delete your account and all your data.
consent.outdated: The document has just changed: read it again, then accept it.
consent.error: Cannot reach the server. Try again in a moment.
